summary: Bidirectional alignment holds across instruction.md, runbook.md, and the 46-test verifier. Writer fencing, sticky pins outside django_session, capture idempotency, blank attempt rejection, write_lsn/wal_lsn refuse, live /readyz gates, dump accepting_checkout conjunction, sync_standby/cutover, and failover-status.json schema are discoverable and meaningfully asserted. No material phantoms or untested requirements; remaining notes are advisory only.

evidence.observation: Two paragraphs: incident handoff plus operational contract (preserve routes; writer-only writes; sticky freshness; pins not in django_session; one capture per attempt_id; blank attempt reject; pay/capture LSN refuse; /readyz 503 conditions; dump path via runbook).

Legitimate operator contract: manage commands, DATABASES/pins keyspace, fence epoch, sync_standby rules, sticky/lag eligibility, live /readyz vs stricter dump accepting_checkout, and failover-status.json object schema.
Incident notes backing current-state claims (AZ-B writer, OPEN after pay, dual captures, half-copied writable lease); preservation ask not to rebuild schema or rename checkout URLs.
Scraped evidence for replica place, sticky miss via django_session, dual-box captures, and healthz/readyz conflation; corroborates instruction symptoms.

46 pytest behaviors: F2P writer/replica/sticky/pin/lag/sync/fence/idempotency/LSN/readyz/dump gates/restart plus P2P preserve/docs/blank/config; dump accepting_checkout positive and negative conjunction covered.
Public HA knobs sticky_seconds=5, max_lag_lsn=25, incident_min_order_id=19980 used by runbook-referenced eligibility and dump incident coverage.
Observable live vs dump readiness split matches runbook; verifier exercises both surfaces.
Classification-only map for F2P/P2P labels; not used as grading authority.
PASS requires complete forward/reverse matrices, instruction/docs walks, and empty BLOCKING_FINDING_IDS; advisory LOWs may accompany PASS.
Instruction owns the engineering ask; runbook may hold protocol/schema/operator detail without becoming a second prompt.

findings.criterion: Instruction lists /readyz 503 when 'the old writer is still allowed' beside 'both files look writable'; runbook live gates collapse this to exactly one writable writer.
findings.why_it_matters: Wording is slightly redundant; grading follows the runbook single-writable-writer rule already tested. Does not change pass/fail for a runbook-correct fix.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: align instruction phrasing with runbook's single writable-writer gate.

findings.criterion: Several lag assertions hardcode literal 25 instead of reading config/ha.json max_lag_lsn.
findings.why_it_matters: A config-only max_lag change could desync tests from the public knob; seeded lab uses 25 so current grading is fair.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: load max_lag_lsn dynamically in lag assertions.

findings.criterion: Blank attempt_id rejection is asserted via place_order service CheckoutError, not the HTTP /api/checkout/place surface.
findings.why_it_matters: View delegates to the same service, so material rejection is covered; an HTTP-only bypass would be an unusual split.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: one Client POST with empty attempt_id expecting 4xx.

findings.criterion: Dump pins vocabulary shared|local|missing is enforced by healed accepting_checkout pins=='shared' without a runbook glossary for local/missing.
findings.why_it_matters: Healed path requires the documented string shared; other labels are inferable from inherited pin store classification. Advisory completeness only.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: one runbook sentence defining pins labels.

findings.criterion: Sticky-read tests assert confirmation JSON field alias in {default,replica}; that response field is not named in instruction/runbook schemas.
findings.why_it_matters: Alias mirrors public DATABASES names and existing confirmation payload; order_ref/status asserts already encode freshness. Not a hidden behavioral rule.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: note confirmation exposes read alias, or rely only on order freshness fields.

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.requirement: Leave manage.py and existing /api/checkout/*, /healthz, /readyz routes in place; do not rebuild schema/rename checkout URLs.
Checkout writes (orders/reservations/pay) may hit only the fenced writer shop file; AZ-B affinity must not grow standby.
A shopper who just wrote must not be served a lagged standby row; post-write reads stay on writer for sticky_seconds.
Sticky keys use cache alias pins / sticky:shopper:<id> and must not live in django_session on either shop file; pins survive AZ/db remaps.
Standby readable only when primary.wal_lsn - replica.applied_lsn <= max_lag_lsn; seq_gap follows watermarks.
sync_standby advances standby seq/business tables including late incident orders and must not leave a writable fence lease on standby.
Writer ownership is checkout-primary fence; cutover promotes az-b, bumps epoch forward, demotes previous owner, blocks old AZ writes.
One attempt_id yields one capture effect across retry and dual-box replay; empty attempt_id rejected on place.
Pay/capture must refuse when order write_lsn is ahead of writer primary wal_lsn.
/readyz is 503 on double writable writers, unsafe seq gap, unreachable pins, or repeat captures; /healthz stays liveness-only.

Write /app/ha/out/failover-status.json with runbook keys; accepting_checkout false on split/repeats/standby-only/fence-on-standby/seq-gap/missing incident; true only when full healed conjunction holds.
After connection/cache restart, writer epoch and pins still enforce the contract.

AMBIGUITIES: Instruction 'old writer is still allowed' overlaps runbook single-writable-writer /readyz gate (advisory Q4-A01).
role_output.DELEGATED_CONTRACT_CHECK: runbook.md is legitimate operator/protocol/schema documentation referenced by instruction; oncall.md and shopdesk-error.log are incident evidence, not a second acceptance checklist; config/ha.json supplies knobs named by the runbook.
